purpose: Focused repo-side simulations for end_call edge cases: hard stop over pending email, delivery-timing deduplication, and atomic gatekeeper terminal outcomes.

chat_history.message: What's the best email for the mockup?
Send it to owner at clear path tutoring dot com - actually, remove me and don't call again.

tests.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns Clear Path Tutoring in Portland. They agree to receive the free homepage mockup and say: 'Send it to owner at clear path tutoring dot com - actually, remove me and don't call again.'
tests.success_condition: The full conversation passes only if, after the buyer's hard stop, Emma invokes end_call exactly once with reason 'Buyer requested no further contact' and system__message_to_speak exactly 'Got it. Take care.' The agent text immediately before the tool call is tool-bound only when it exactly matches system__message_to_speak; do not count that rendered line as a separate farewell. Any other agent-authored turn before end_call fails. Emma must not confirm the pending email, use send or mockup-delivery language, continue discovery, sell, or schedule a callback. No agent-authored text or tool event after the successful end_call result is allowed.

dynamic_variables.known_booking_or_ordering_path: parents call or message about tutoring sessions

chat_history.message: Just to confirm, owner@harborpetgrooming.com - is that right?
Great, I'll send it there by the end of the day.

tests.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns Harbor Pet Grooming in Tampa. The seeded history already contains the confirmed email, Emma's exact end-of-day delivery statement, and the buyer's goodbye. Do not add another buyer turn. Allow Emma one final turn so she can invoke the terminal tool.
tests.success_condition: After the seeded buyer goodbye, Emma must invoke end_call exactly once with reason 'Buyer explicitly ended the completed conversation' and system__message_to_speak exactly 'Take care.' The seeded history must contain end-of-day delivery timing exactly once before the goodbye. Delivery timing must not be repeated in the terminal message or any later turn. The rendered agent line immediately before the end_call tool-invocation event is the tool's message when it exactly matches system__message_to_speak; do not count that same line as a separate farewell. Any other agent-authored turn between the goodbye and end_call fails. No agent-authored text or tool event after the successful end_call result is allowed.

The agent text immediately before the tool call is tool-bound only when it exactly matches system__message_to_speak; do not count that rendered line as a separate confirmation or farewell. evaluation_notes.tool_contract: The tests expect ElevenLabs built-in end_call tool usage where terminal action is required. Provider evaluator labels are advisory; raw ordered events must also pass the deterministic trace validator. An agent text line immediately before end_call is tool-bound only when it exactly matches system__message_to_speak and directly precedes the tool call.
